system.description:
You become [Flying], and may make a [Safe Move] up to your [[Speed] + 2] Sq. After the end of this movement, you lose [Flying] gained from this skill. 

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special ability to move while jumping lightly like a bouncing unicorn. It looks like it's flying in the sky.
